model.description: Betty's Eddies Lemon Agave Bedtime Betty's chews deliver 50mg of hybrid cannabis in a delicious, sleep-focused edible. Crafted by Betty's Eddies, these thoughtfully formulated chews combine the bright, zesty flavor of lemon with the smooth sweetness of agave for a perfectly balanced taste experience. As a hybrid product, Bedtime Betty's offers the best of both worlds—gentle relaxation to ease you into restful sleep while maintaining mental clarity. Each chew is designed to help you unwind after a long day, promoting calm and tranquility without overwhelming sedation. The 50mg potency makes these ideal for experienced consumers seeking reliable nighttime relief. Whether you're looking to quiet a busy mind or simply enhance your evening routine, Betty's Eddies Lemon Agave Bedtime Betty's provides a delicious, effective way to support better sleep naturally.
